title: Process-Mining (from Business Operations) of the Model-Release Decision Workflow

original_idea.body:
# Process-Mining (from Business Operations) of the Model-Release Decision Workflow

**Problem:** Governance wants to know how release decisions are actually made, but workflows are described narratively. Process mining reconstructs and audits real processes from event traces — a technique never applied to AI release governance.

**Direction:** Transfer process-mining's workflow-conformance idea. From public framework text, reconstruct the intended release-decision process as a flow (evaluation → risk estimation → decision gate → mitigation), then compare against what published model/system cards reveal actually happened for specific releases, flagging skipped or out-of-order steps.

**Why it matters:** Surfaces gaps between declared and revealed release processes — a conformance check regulators need — using only public documents. Operationalizes the safety-objective-to-practice gap.

**Relevant context:** Process mining / conformance checking (van der Aalst); EU Code of Practice release-decision process; published system cards; dynamic safety cases (arXiv 2412.17618).
